content:
Asha (PM): Quick lunchtime sync 1: drafting a compact GA readiness "floorcheck" focused on SLA, support routing, docs, monitoring, and a published pricing floor. Need to assign owners and call out any absolute no-ships before I lock.

Marco (Infra): I can own perf SLO validation + autoscale smoke. Heads up: long-sequence mem-fragmentation bug still exists but we can document as deferred tech debt with a mitigation (max seq warning). Not GA-blocking.

Lynn (SRE): I'll take monitoring, canaries, and runbooks. Must-haves: synthetic correctness canary, p99 latency tail alerting, and a tested fallback path to model-variants. Also want a scripted region-failover drill in CI.

Tariq (FinOps): Pricing floor: i'll produce a published GA price sheet (hosted/embeddings/reserved tiers) next week. GA can ship with "published floor" and a note that enterprise tiers are finalizing. Need an example commit scenario for sales.

Asha (PM): Proposed minimal GA checklist (respond with :thumbsup: to accept or call out blockers):

```
GA MINIMAL FLOORCHECK (owners)
- SLA: Dedicated 99.9% monthly uptime, Hosted 99.5% (owner: Asha)
- Latency targets: publish p50/p95 by model family; engineering to target p95 <= 200ms for short chats (owner: Marco)
- Monitoring: synthetic canaries (latency + correctness), p99 tail alerts, burn-rate alerts for error spikes (owner: Lynn)
- Runbooks: SEV1/SEV2 + model-fallback and throttling playbooks (owner: Lynn)
- Autoscale & Failover: autoscale smoke harness + scripted regional failover CI job (owners: Marco/Lynn)
- Docs: GA quickstart, migration notes for pilots, operational expectations page (owner: Asha)
- Support: business-hours triage + SEV1 escalation path (owner: Asha)
- Pricing: published floor for GA + example commit scenarios (owner: Tariq)
```

Marco (Infra): I'll drop the autoscale smoke PR by Tue. Blocking: need capacity burst test infra and a KV cold-start regression test.

Lynn (SRE): Blocking: regional failover automation and fallback under saturated load need to be validated. I'll add tests to CI and write the fallback runbook.

Tariq (FinOps): I'll share a draft price floor and two commit examples by Fri. Sales can use that for pilot-to-GA comms.

ship-bot: Created ticket PRD-9001 (autoscale-smoke) and PRD-9002 (regional-failover-drill); assignees Marco, Lynn.

Asha (PM): If no hard blockers by EOD I'll lock this for the shiproom agenda. Call out anything that must not ship under GA now.

Marco (Infra): marking mem-frag flake as deferred with mitigation noted. not blocking.

Lynn (SRE): :thumbsup: pending failover validation tickets.

Tariq (FinOps): :thumbsup: (will follow up with numbers).
